target.learningOutcome: The learner can name the three composed annotations, explain the job of each, predict the default component-scan boundary, and use a targeted auto-configuration exclusion when needed.
outOfScope: A claim that the annotation scans the whole classpath

claims.statement: SpringBootApplication is equivalent to declaring SpringBootConfiguration, EnableAutoConfiguration, and ComponentScan together.
SpringBootConfiguration identifies Boot's application configuration and is a specialized form of Spring Configuration.
Without an explicit base package, component scanning begins from the package of the annotated application class and includes its subpackages.
SpringBootApplication exposes exclude and excludeName attributes that can prevent selected auto-configuration classes from applying.
